statements:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS authority_revocation (
 revocation_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 authority_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES authority(authority_id),
 cascade_root TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES authority(authority_id),
 actor_kind TEXT NOT NULL, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 reason TEXT NOT NULL, occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exit_process (
 exit_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, person_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES person(person_id),
 core_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES core(core_id), requested_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, stage TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS core_exit_relation (
 relation_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, person_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES person(person_id),
 core_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES core(core_id), kind TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('ACTIVE','CLOSED')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exit_obligation (
 obligation_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, person_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES person(person_id),
 core_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES core(core_id), description TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('OPEN','RETAINED','FULFILLED')), resolution TEXT, resolved_at TEXT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS owned_exit_evidence (
 evidence_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, person_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES person(person_id),
 core_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES core(core_id), description TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_event_id TEXT, recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exit_governance_audit (
 id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, person_id TEXT NOT NULL, core_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 operation TEXT NOT NULL, actor_kind TEXT NOT NULL, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 authority_id TEXT NOT NULL, evidence TEXT NOT NULL, occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS historical_record_approval (
 event_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, canonical_record TEXT NOT NULL,
 actor_kind TEXT NOT NULL, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL, key_id TEXT NOT NULL, public_key_base64 TEXT NOT NULL,
 target TEXT NOT NULL, operator_kind TEXT NOT NULL, operator_id TEXT NOT NULL, authority_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 purpose TEXT NOT NULL, approved_at TEXT NOT NULL, evidence_reference TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS historical_record_revocation (
 event_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES historical_record_approval(event_id),
 target TEXT NOT NULL, operator_kind TEXT NOT NULL, operator_id TEXT NOT NULL, authority_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 purpose TEXT NOT NULL, revoked_at TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE local_credential_audit (
    audit_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    unit_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    login_handle TEXT NOT NULL,
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    operation TEXT NOT NULL,
    actor_person_id TEXT,
    occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY(unit_id, login_handle) REFERENCES local_credential(unit_id, login_handle)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trusted_peer (
    peer_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    policy_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    credential_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    active INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS provisioning_audit (
    audit_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    target TEXT NOT NULL,
    operation TEXT NOT NULL,
    actor_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    authority_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    purpose TEXT NOT NULL,
    occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS relation_obligation (
 relation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES relation_terms(relation_id),
 obligation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES exit_obligation(obligation_id),
 PRIMARY KEY(relation_id, obligation_id));

CREATE TABLE identity (
    identity_id  TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    person_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    local_handle TEXT NOT NULL,
    external_refs_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    FOREIGN KEY (person_id) REFERENCES person(person_id)
);

CREATE TABLE membership (
    membership_id   TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    person_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    collective_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    collective_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
    role_id         TEXT,
    start_at        TEXT NOT NULL,
    end_at          TEXT,
    state           TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (person_id) REFERENCES person(person_id)
);

CREATE TABLE authority (
    authority_id     TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    issuer_kind      TEXT NOT NULL,
    issuer_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    subject_kind     TEXT NOT NULL,
    subject_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope_json       TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_json     TEXT NOT NULL,
    basis_json       TEXT NOT NULL,
    valid_from       TEXT NOT NULL,
    valid_until      TEXT,
    accountable_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    accountable_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
    state            TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_authority_id TEXT REFERENCES authority(authority_id)
);

CREATE TABLE mission (
    mission_id        TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    owner_kind        TEXT NOT NULL,
    owner_id          TEXT NOT NULL,
    intent            TEXT NOT NULL,
    objectives_json   TEXT NOT NULL,
    participants_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    mode              TEXT NOT NULL,
    state             TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE decision (
    decision_id   TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    subject_kind  TEXT NOT NULL,
    subject_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    intent_ref    TEXT NOT NULL,
    options_json  TEXT NOT NULL,
    chosen_option TEXT NOT NULL,
    authority_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp     TEXT NOT NULL,
    purpose       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Execute mission action',
    affected_persons_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    FOREIGN KEY (authority_ref) REFERENCES authority(authority_id)
);

CREATE TABLE action (
    action_id     TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    actor_kind    TEXT NOT NULL,
    actor_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
    authority_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
    decision_ref  TEXT,
    context_json  TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp     TEXT NOT NULL,
    mode          TEXT NOT NULL,
    target        TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (authority_ref) REFERENCES authority(authority_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (decision_ref) REFERENCES decision(decision_id)
);

CREATE TABLE result (
    result_id   TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    action_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT NOT NULL,
    outcome     TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp   TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (action_id) REFERENCES action(action_id)
);

CREATE TABLE event (
    event_id        TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    type            TEXT NOT NULL,
    actor_kind      TEXT NOT NULL,
    actor_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp       TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_json    TEXT NOT NULL,
    authority_ref   TEXT,
    decision_ref    TEXT,
    payload_json    TEXT NOT NULL,
    result_ref      TEXT,
    provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_hash    TEXT NOT NULL,
    signature       TEXT,
    corrects_event_id TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE experience (
    experience_id        TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    derived_events_json  TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_json         TEXT NOT NULL,
    what_was_tried        TEXT NOT NULL,
    outcome               TEXT NOT NULL,
    conclusion            TEXT NOT NULL,
    applicability         TEXT NOT NULL,
    confidence             TEXT NOT NULL,
    provenance_json        TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE knowledge (
    knowledge_id             TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    statement                TEXT NOT NULL,
    derived_experience_json  TEXT NOT NULL,
    evidence_json            TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_json             TEXT NOT NULL,
    status                   TEXT NOT NULL,
    version                  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    supersedes               TEXT,
    provenance_json          TEXT NOT NULL,
    validated_by_kind        TEXT,
    validated_by_id          TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE right_record (
    right_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    subject_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    subject_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    right_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    source TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    constraints_json TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE consent (
    consent_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    subject_person_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    recipient_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    recipient_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    purpose TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    notice TEXT NOT NULL,
    affirmation TEXT NOT NULL,
    granted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    valid_until TEXT,
    revoked_at TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (subject_person_id) REFERENCES person(person_id)
);

CREATE TABLE authentication_binding (
    unit_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    provider_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    provider_subject TEXT NOT NULL,
    person_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    linked_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (unit_id, provider_id, provider_subject),
    FOREIGN KEY (person_id) REFERENCES person(person_id)
);

CREATE TABLE local_credential (
    unit_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    provider_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local-passphrase',
    login_handle TEXT NOT NULL,
    salt_base64 TEXT NOT NULL,
    hash_base64 TEXT NOT NULL,
    iterations INTEGER NOT NULL,
    failed_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    locked_until TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    revoked_at TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (unit_id, login_handle),
    FOREIGN KEY (unit_id, provider_id, login_handle)
        REFERENCES authentication_binding(unit_id, provider_id, provider_subject)
    );

CREATE TABLE sync_conflict (
    entity_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    left_event_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event(event_id),
    right_event_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event(event_id),
    PRIMARY KEY(entity_kind, entity_id, left_event_id, right_event_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS verified_sync_record (
 event_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES event(event_id),
 canonical_record TEXT NOT NULL,
 actor_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
 actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 key_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 public_key_base64 TEXT NOT NULL,
 verified_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 historical_approval_target TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS authority_parent_idx ON authority(parent_authority_id);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS exit_one_open ON exit_process(person_id, core_id) WHERE stage != 'COMPLETED' ;

CREATE TRIGGER credential_audit_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON local_credential_audit
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'credential audit is append-only'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER credential_audit_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON local_credential_audit
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'credential audit is append-only'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER event_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON event
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'event rows are append-only'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER event_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON event
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'event rows are append-only'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER sync_journal_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON sync_journal
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'sync history is append-only'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER sync_journal_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON sync_journal
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'sync history is append-only'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER sync_conflict_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON sync_conflict
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'conflicts are historical facts'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER sync_conflict_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON sync_conflict
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'conflicts are historical facts'); END;
